snippet.title: Dark Watching Chapter 1 | 2.5 Update release trailer
snippet.description:
Dark Watching: Chapter 1 – The Bunker is a gripping first-person horror adventure. You play as Jacob, searching for your missing sister. Your path leads through an abandoned bunker full of secrets, puzzles, and deadly dangers.
